list.name: vin
list.label: Vehicle
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT vehicle_id FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id != 'DEMO0000000000000' ORDER BY vehicle_id

targets.rawSql: SELECT formatDateTime(min(ts),'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS started, round(dateDiff('second',min(ts),max(ts))/60.0,1) AS minutes, count() AS samples, round(maxIf(value,channel='vehicle.speed' AND quality='ok'),0) AS max_kmh, round(maxIf(value,channel='engine.rpm' AND quality='ok'),0) AS max_rpm FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' GROUP BY session_id HAVING samples>2000 ORDER BY started DESC

panels.title: DPF ΔP vs exhaust flow (restriction baseline)
panels.description: Median differential pressure binned by engine MAF. Trend this up over months = filter loading up at comparable flow. Only quality='ok' readings: sentinel, saturated and clipped values are not measurements and are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(round(maf,-1)) AS maf_gps, round(quantile(0.5)(dp),1) AS median_dP_hPa FROM (SELECT a.value AS dp, b.value AS maf FROM (SELECT vehicle_id, ts, value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='dpf.differential_pressure' AND quality='ok') a ASOF LEFT JOIN (SELECT vehicle_id, ts, value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='engine.maf' AND quality='ok') b ON a.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND a.ts>=b.ts) WHERE maf IS NOT NULL GROUP BY maf_gps ORDER BY toFloat64(maf_gps)

panels.title: Boost tracking |actual − setpoint| by RPM
panels.description: Mean absolute boost deviation, conditioned on RPM. A growing baseline = actuator/wastegate wear. Only quality='ok' readings: sentinel, saturated and clipped values are not measurements and are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT multiIf(rpm<1000,'0 idle',rpm<1800,'1 1000-1800',rpm<2600,'2 1800-2600','3 2600+') AS rpm_band, round(avg(abs(dev)),1) AS mean_abs_dev_hPa FROM (SELECT a.value-b.value AS dev, c.value AS rpm FROM (SELECT vehicle_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='engine.boost.actual' AND quality='ok') a ASOF LEFT JOIN (SELECT vehicle_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='engine.boost.setpoint' AND quality='ok') b ON a.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND a.ts>=b.ts ASOF LEFT JOIN (SELECT vehicle_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='engine.rpm' AND quality='ok') c ON a.vehicle_id=c.vehicle_id AND a.ts>=c.ts) WHERE rpm IS NOT NULL GROUP BY rpm_band ORDER BY rpm_band

panels.title: DPF soot vs distance since regen
panels.description: Soot accumulation. The slope (g/km) is a DPF-health baseline; a steeper slope over time points at injectors/EGR/combustion. Only quality='ok' readings: sentinel, saturated and clipped values are not measurements and are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toString(round(dist,0)) AS dist_km, round(quantile(0.5)(soot),2) AS soot_g FROM (SELECT a.value AS dist, b.value AS soot FROM (SELECT vehicle_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='dpf.distance_since_regeneration' AND quality='ok') a ASOF LEFT JOIN (SELECT vehicle_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='dpf.soot_mass.measured' AND quality='ok') b ON a.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND a.ts>=b.ts) WHERE soot IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dist_km ORDER BY toFloat64(dist_km)

panels.title: DDE vs OBD coolant agreement per drive
panels.description: Mean |difference| between the proprietary and standard coolant reads. Should stay near 0; drifting up flags a sensor. Only quality='ok' readings: sentinel, saturated and clipped values are not measurements and are excluded.

targets.rawSql: SELECT formatDateTime(min_ts,'%Y-%m-%d %H:%M') AS drive, mean_abs_diff_degC, pairs FROM (SELECT session_id, min(a.ts) AS min_ts, round(avg(abs(a.value-b.value)),3) AS mean_abs_diff_degC, count() AS pairs FROM (SELECT vehicle_id,session_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel_raw='n47d_coolant' AND quality='ok') a ASOF LEFT JOIN (SELECT vehicle_id,ts,value FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel_raw='coolant' AND quality='ok') b ON a.vehicle_id=b.vehicle_id AND a.ts>=b.ts GROUP BY session_id HAVING pairs>20) ORDER BY min_ts DESC

panels.title: OBD MAP saturated (255 kPa)
panels.description: Reads the quality label the decoder recorded, not a value threshold. CAVEAT: rows recorded before the data-quality layer landed are all 'ok' because nothing was labelling them, not because they were verified clean - so this understates the rate over history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0*countIf(quality='saturated')/count() AS pct FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='engine.manifold_pressure.absolute'

panels.title: Lambda at 2.0 sentinel (no-value)
panels.description: Reads the quality label the decoder recorded, not a value threshold. CAVEAT: rows recorded before the data-quality layer landed are all 'ok' because nothing was labelling them, not because they were verified clean - so this understates the rate over history.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 100.0*countIf(quality='sentinel')/count() AS pct FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin' AND channel='engine.lambda'
SELECT count() AS samples FROM telemetry.samples WHERE vehicle_id='$vin'
